description: Newcastle's LIVE-STATE documentation claims - the CITY-OWNED half of tests/check_doc_currency.py. Each entry pins one number written into a document to the artefact that decides it, so a figure cannot silently outlive the thing it describes. A second city supplies its own copy at cities/<city>/tests/doc_currency.json; the harness in tests/ names no city, no document and no number.
what_belongs_here: ONLY live-state cells - a table row or sentence that must equal the artefact TODAY. A dated record is frozen and must never be claimed: DECISIONS.md 14 saying 'manifest 436' on 24 August is history, and STATUS.md's dated task rows are the same. Claiming a record would force the project to rewrite its own past to keep a check green, which is the exact opposite of the reproducibility rule.
why_these_two_documents: README.md is the front door, STATUS.md is the board, .claude/CLAUDE.md and docs/README.md frame the project for every session, and GOAL.md states what it is for - all are read for current state. NEXT_AGENT_BRIEF.md carries no pinned NUMBER (it is rewritten every session and its family stamp is checked by tests/check_doc_shape.py), but it does carry the banned-statement claims: a stale sentence is exactly as wrong in a brief as anywhere else. ONE position page is pinned as well, from 8 September 2026 (DECISIONS.md 9.158): positions/network-and-inputs.md is the only one that states the package's live counts - the registry's field count and the manifest's row count - and its field count had been stale at 472 for weeks. Every OTHER position page stays outside this check by design: they are topic pages rewritten at every /handoff, and their vintage is guarded by the family stamp in tests/check_doc_shape.py rather than by a pinned number.

claims.reason: The issue #32 re-harvest RAN on 16 August 2026 and #32 is closed: networks/osm/ holds its 10 layers and check_package.py passes at 1,433 checks. Every phrasing of 'the package is not built yet' is banned together, because the first ban named ONE wording and the same false statement survived in the resume instructions under another - found by hand on 25 August, which is exactly the work this check exists to stop being hand work.

claims.pattern: newest run on disk is `([^`]+)`, which \*\*
claims.note: the phase table's P4 cell names the arm whose state it then states; naming a run the store does not hold at the top of the board is how a stale cell survives a family boundary RE-AIMED 10 Sep 2026 (§9.164): the cell said "newest arm" and the newest run is now a 1 % PROBE, which this project does not call an arm. The claim is about whatever the store holds newest, so it is re-aimed rather than retired.

claims.pattern: newest run on disk is `[^`]+`, which \*\*([A-Z][A-Z ]*[A-Z])\*\*
claims.note: THE ONE ERROR THIS BOARD HAS MADE TWICE. The phase table said F30's arm 'is RUNNING' while it was dead, and then said F31's arm 'is RUNNING' while its own _run.json said stopped_at_gate at iteration 100 - with the State block, the Runs block, the Next section and the brief all saying otherwise on the same page. A run's state is a fact its record holds, so the cell that states it is pinned to the record. The words are the board's; the mapping is here because the harness holds no city's wording.

claims.pattern: SCATS (signal )?phasing[^.\n]{0,120}(handled by (parameter )?sweep|swept, never pinned|stays? `?unobtained`?|remains? unobtained)|three (unobtained )?inputs[^.\n]{0,60}stay unobtained|handled\s+by sweep, not by\s+assumption
claims.reason: Since DECISIONS.md 9.88 (28 Aug 2026, family F12) the SCATS algorithm is IMPLEMENTED natively - citysim.ScatsSignalController adapts cycle and splits on measured degree of saturation, and the scats module is in every emitted config.xml. What remains unobtained is the operated phase plans and the offset library, and GOAL.md requirement 6 forbids describing a derivable input as 'handled by sweep'. Every phrasing of the old statement is banned together because it survived in four documents after the algorithm shipped.

claims.pattern: No scenario has been run|P3 demand synthesis complete\.|Nothing in the repo is a result|No counterfactual has been run, and nothing here is a finding
claims.reason: Runs have executed since 16 Aug 2026 (results/INDEX.md lists over a hundred directories) and the base was measured on 21 Aug (9.64); the counterfactual framing is not the goal (GOAL.md). A stage sentence belongs on the board's phase table, not in a conventions file or the front door.

claims.pattern: applied first as a counterfactual\s+microsimulation|counterfactual microsimulation of the \*\*?Newcastle Light Rail\*\*? as a transport\s+intervention — MATSim end to end
claims.reason: The project is the twin (GOAL.md, 30 Aug 2026); the light-rail counterfactual is the frozen origin design and its first application. Defining the project by the counterfactual in the front door or the conventions file re-frames every session on the superseded goal.
